evidence.note: Flat white background with no grain or texture; nodes are large rounded white cards with soft shadows.
Large dark serif title; body copy is large mid-grey sans with generous line spacing, readable.
Arrows are roughly 2 px strokes in grey, blue and red with clear arrowheads; thinnest marks on the slide but not 1 px hairlines.
At the small window the node labels and callout text stay legible; the check-mark badges on the scorer shrink to about 14 px and the grey arrows thin out, the weakest elements.
Insight card is opaque with large serif text over a blurred background; fully readable at small size.

rationale: The slide uses flat colour, big soft card shapes and generous type, with no texture, grain or 1 px grid lines. The thinnest elements are the ~2 px diagram arrows and small check badges at 1288x598, which thin out but remain visible and are reinforced by colour and the callout text. That matches the pass descriptor rather than the hairline/faint-text failure.
